background: Macquarie Bank is the banking entity of Macquarie Group, Australia's largest investment bank, funded by Australian deposits and wholesale markets and lending on residential mortgages, to businesses and in asset finance, alongside its commodities and markets business.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the bank, AA- on average and the weakest of them at A+, both on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 26 May 2024. The paragraph carries no capital or liquidity ratios, so the ratings are the whole of the published picture here. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
